name: compact-warning
description: Warns Claude before auto-compaction, so it stops at a good breakpoint and hands you a ready /compact line.

warnPercent.title: First nudge (%)
warnPercent.description: Claude starts to look for a breakpoint when the context reaches this percentage of the auto-compaction point.

stopPercent.title: Second nudge (%)
stopPercent.description: Claude stops at the next breakpoint when the context reaches this percentage of the auto-compaction point.

warnTokens.title: First nudge (tokens)
warnTokens.description: Also give the first nudge when the context reaches this many tokens. 0 turns this off.

stopTokens.title: Second nudge (tokens)
stopTokens.description: Also give the second nudge when the context reaches this many tokens. 0 turns this off.

reserveTokens.title: Room for the hand-over (tokens)
reserveTokens.description: On a small context window, both nudges come earlier, so that this many tokens remain before auto-compaction. 0 turns this off.

unattended.title: Compact without asking
unattended.description: Compact as soon as Claude proposes it, then tell Claude to continue. Off: put the /compact line in the prompt box and wait for Enter.
